title: 11 Why we are to deſire that the kingdome of god come.

segments.text: WE ought to deſire, that the kingdome of god come, 1. For the glorie of god, or in reſpect of the firſt petition; becauſe that wee may ſanctifie & hallow his name it is required that he rule vs by his word & ſpirit. For except god erect in vs this his kingdome, & deliuer vs out of the kingdome of the diuell, we ſhall neuer hallowe & ſanctify his name, but rather ſhall defile & pollute it. 2 Becauſe god will giue this kingdome onlie to thoſe that aske it, like as he giueth the holie ghoſt vnto them onlie, that aske him.
